_comment: Authoritative measured results. Every number quoted in README.md must appear
here with matching value, or CI fails. See evaluation/check_docs.py.
Each entry records provenance so a claim can be traced to the computation
that produced it. 'source' must point at a file in this repository.
Do not edit a value here to make a document pass. Re-run the computation,
update this file from its output, then regenerate the document.

cmu_baseline_scaled_manhattan_eer.description: Published baseline. We do not beat this yet.

cmu_if_vs_ocsvm_t_statistic.description: Paired t-test, Isolation Forest vs One-Class SVM. Reported as 3.1127.

cmu_if_vs_ocsvm_p_value.description: Reported as 0.0031. NOT the 4.7e-21 from the Advanced notebook, which t-tested a vector against itself scaled by 1.1.
